text:
nora: quick check-in: proposing a tiny runtime preflight that runs after ingest checks. focused: tokenizer parity, kv-cache smoke, and a minimal perf sanity check (1 short, 1 long sequence). aim for ~45-90s per model. thoughts?

sam: sounds good. prefer run in ephemeral container using model's runtime image to catch link-time issues. will need pull-caching.

diego: +1 but we need to decide failure semantics. tokenization mismatch should block. perf margin issues could be advisory. kv-cache crashes block.

rachel: add: tokenizer artifact should be versioned and stored with the model metadata. we should compare token ids not strings and normalize unicode.

ci-bot: reminder: adding more CI jobs might increase billing; please tag PRs targeting bench-runner with @finance.

nora: draft contract sketch in-line: 
```
preflight_contract:
  checks:
    - tokenize_parity:
        golden_prompts: ["edge: emoji 👍", "multibyte: 北京"]
        strict: true
    - kv_smoke:
        seq_lengths: [8, 256]
        crash_block: true
    - perf_sanity:
        threshold_tps: 4500
        advisory: true
  artifacts:
    - tokenizer_sha
    - runtime_image_sha
    - tokenize_diff_path
    - kv_trace_path
    - perf_summary
```

sam: for golden prompts, owners should supply at least 2; otherwise default set used. owners can opt-out but must accept advisory risk in UI.

diego: normalization: NFKC + remove ZWJ/ZWSP before token compare. also compare token ids.

rachel: logging artifact needs to include deterministic diff and metadata for repro: dockerfile, runtime args, python lib versions.

ci-bot: note: last month had 6 docker pull timeouts in ap-southeast-1; recommend mirror and retry logic.

nora: action items: (1) i'll add a prototype shim module to bench-runner repo as optional config (2) sam will implement ephemeral runner with pull cache and backoff (3) diego will produce normalization util and token-id comparator (4) rachel will add model metadata fields for tokenizer sha and runtime hashes. i'll open a short RFC PR.

sam: will include budget estimate for expected runs and a rate-limit control per org.

diego: include a test harness that simulates small variations in tokenizer to avoid flaky diffs.

rachel: UX note: when failure occurs, show quick options: re-run, upload tokenizer, or escalate. reduces triage time.

nora: thanks. i'll ship the PR with a demo gif. :sparkles:
